---

This section summarises the HYDRA-EO work packages (WPs), outlining their
scope, role, and position within the overall project timeline. Each work
package contributes a specific set of activities—ranging from scientific
requirements and data collection to modelling, integration, and
dissemination—together forming a coherent end-to-end workflow.

---

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP1
:::
### Scientific requirement consolidation
Definition of scientific objectives, use cases, trait–stressor matrix,
and alignment with ESA requirements and parallel EU initiatives.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP2
:::
### Dataset collection
Field campaigns, UAV and airborne acquisitions, in-situ measurements, and
harmonised dataset documentation across crops and sites.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP3
:::
### Model development & validation
Development and validation of RTMs and EO-based models, including spectral
sensitivity and sensor intercomparison.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP4
:::
### Experimental dataset generation
Generation of experimental EO products, synthetic datasets, and
stress-specific simulation libraries.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP5
:::
### Earth system science exploitation
Analysis of functional traits, stress dynamics, and scaling from UAV to
satellite EO products.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP6
:::
### Societal relevance & transfer
Demonstration of applicability for agriculture, disease monitoring, and
resilience, including stakeholder-oriented outputs.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP7
:::
### Scientific roadmap
Identification of knowledge gaps and recommendations for future EO
missions (CHIME, FLEX, LSTM).
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP8
:::
### Scientific collaboration
Coordination with ESA activities and relevant Horizon Europe projects.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP9
:::
### Promotion & dissemination
Scientific communication, training material, workshops, and outreach
activities.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
WP10
:::
### Project management
Overall coordination, reporting, risk management, and contractual
compliance.
:::

:::
